cost.value: a gemstone worth at least 25 gp (consumed)

description.value:
You spend ten minutes channeling magical energy into a touched object, storing a temporal charge within it. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, or void. Also speak a command word (a unique word or phrase) in a language you know. The charged object is otherwise unchanged in appearance; a successful Recall Knowledge or Seek check against your spell DC reveals the presence of a magical aura.

Trigger: The first time a creature touches the object without speaking the command word within 6 seconds of touching it, the stored energy discharges, requiring the triggering creature to attempt a basic Reflex save against your spell DC and take 10d6 damage of the chosen type.

The object is not destroyed by the discharge.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6, and the duration extends by 1 day per additional rank (until the caster's next daily preparations plus 1 day at rank 5, etc., to a maximum of 1 week at rank 7).

duration.value: until discharged or until your next daily preparations
